label: Diagram 3.4
caption: Diagram 3.4 Floor type 1.2B – floor type 1.2 with ceiling treatment B
description:
The image is a framed cross-section drawing titled, in a green band at the top, "Diagram 3.4 Floor type 1.2B – floor type 1.2 with ceiling treatment B". The word "SECTION" appears in the bottom right corner of the frame.

The section shows a horizontal floor build-up made of stacked layers. The topmost layer is a plain band with scattered speckles. Beneath it runs a horizontal row of evenly spaced small open circles; at the centre of this row the circle is replaced by a hatched diamond shape, linked by a thin vertical line that runs down to the bottom band. Below the row of circles is a thinner plain band, and at the bottom is a band filled with a short hatched/ribbed pattern, split into two lengths by a small central gap. A label reading "Timber batten" sits below the drawing, with an arrow pointing up to that central gap in the hatched band. No dimensions or scale are shown.
